The plate looks like a square side plate of roughly 20 cm. It holds thin cucumber slices, which look like pickled or marinated cucumber with a few bits of carrot. I count about 10 to 12 half-moon slices, each about 4-5 cm across and 2-3 mm thick. At roughly 3 g per slice, that comes to about 35 g. The carrot is only a few tiny shreds, so I put it at about 1 g.
